_comment: Per-style PROMPT VOCABULARY, written from the actual baseline images. The selected style's entry is injected into produce/regen briefs as the mandatory style preamble for every image prompt — replacing any hardcoded sketchnote/whiteboard wording in skill docs. The baseline image itself is always the final authority: workers extend/correct this vocabulary from what they see in it.
00-default-whiteboard: Hand-drawn sketchnote-on-paper: warm cream paper, faint pencil grid, thin black frame with corner brackets, pastel corner scribbles. Muted pastel palette (pale sky blue, mint, buttercream, dusty coral, manila tan) with charcoal linework, bouncy hand-lettered black titles, expressive stick figures, cloud thought bubbles, manila price tags, bold cross-hatched block arrows.
01-corporate-clean: Clean corporate explainer: white ground with a faint square grid, a solid navy title band across the top with white caps headline, rounded navy and rust-orange pill labels, flat medium-stroke vector illustration (navy outlines, mint-green and steel-blue fills), simple smiling figures, bold navy block arrows with white caps text, tidy symmetric two-panel layout.
02-dark-executive: Dark tech keynote: deep navy ground with a faint hexagon mesh pattern, glowing neon outline illustration in teal/cyan, warm orange glow for danger elements, headline in white plus gold caps, glowing rounded pill badges (teal and red outlines), soft light bloom around key objects, sleek high-contrast cinematic polish.
03-flat-infographic: Flat design infographic: off-white ground with big soft pastel blob shapes in the corners (mint, peach, aqua), two rounded color-block panels (powder blue and peach), flat vector characters and objects with NO outlines, coral-red chunky rounded arrow, heavy black condensed sans caps headline and labels, cheerful orderly composition.
04-isometric-3d: Soft isometric 3D: pale gray-blue ground, miniature diorama scenes on floating isometric platforms, smooth matte plastic-like surfaces with gentle gradient shading, muted palette (sage green, slate blue, terracotta, cream), extruded 3D ribbon banners as labels with white caps, soft contact shadows, navy sans headline, no outlines.
05-swiss-typography: Swiss poster: stark white ground, an enormous ultra-condensed black caps headline spanning the full width, flat primary label blocks (cobalt blue, signal red) with white caps text, thick black monoline illustration with minimal fills, one thin vertical rule divider, small tight caption text, disciplined grid and generous whitespace.
06-pastel-notebook: Storybook notebook page: soft cream paper with faint ruling, loose colored-pencil scribble decorations in the corners (pink, yellow, blue), gentle children's-book illustration (soft pencil-and-wash characters with rosy cheeks), cloud-shaped label bubbles in powder blue and coral, warm brown rounded hand-lettering, cozy muted greens and clay reds.
07-blueprint-technical: Engineering blueprint: deep cobalt ground with a fine drafting grid, precise white line-work only, stencil-style caps headline, framed panels with corner ticks, dimension arrows and measurements (H = 8.5 UNITS), leader-line annotations in small caps, a compass rose, dashed data-flow arrows, everything reads as a technical drawing.
08-glassmorphism-saas: Glassmorphism SaaS: soft lavender-to-mint gradient background with bokeh light spots, frosted translucent glass cards with thin light borders and soft shadows, rounded pill badges with tiny icons (mint and blush), polished 3D-render objects and a realistic friendly person, clean white rounded sans type with letterspaced caps labels.
09-newspaper-editorial: Vintage newspaper: aged off-white newsprint with subtle stains, massive black condensed serif caps headline, thin-ruled boxed panels, fine ink etching/crosshatch illustration in black and white, dark red reserved as the single accent for danger, italic serif caption line, small ornamental divider.
10-brutalist-poster: Brutalist zine poster: distressed black rough border, crushed ultra-bold grotesque caps filling the top, raw marker/woodcut-style illustration with scratchy black strokes, flat primary frames (blue, red) and green fills, grungy ink spatter texture, aggressive black brush arrow, zero polish, loud and abrasive.
11-consulting-mckinsey: Top-tier consulting slide: white ground, thin teal bar across the very top, navy serif-leaning headline in title case, two thin-bordered panels with small letterspaced teal caps labels, minimal thin monoline illustration (navy on white, one mint accent), a navy full-width takeaway bar at the bottom with italic serif white text, austere and precise.
12-comic-book: Comic book page: cream ground with visible halftone dots, jagged starburst banner holding the black caps title, thick-inked panels with flat comic color (sky blue, grass green, mustard), a yellow speed-line burst panel, black action arrow with white caps, red and blue label banners, hand-lettered onomatopoeia (PLINK!), energetic cartoon characters.
13-watercolor-keynote: Watercolor keynote: cold-press paper texture, loose wet watercolor blooms bleeding in from the corners (indigo, sage, rust), circular wash badges holding hand-lettered labels, soft illustrated scenes with muted natural palette, dark navy relaxed hand-lettering for headline and caption, plenty of unpainted white breathing room.
14-chalkboard: Green chalkboard: deep green board with chalk-dust texture and eraser smudges, white chalk line-work with grainy strokes, boxed chalk label frames, warm orange and yellow chalk as the only accents, rounded friendly chalk hand-lettering, diagram energy of a classroom lecture, soft yellow glow highlights.
15-paper-cut-collage: Paper-cut collage: kraft cardboard ground, layered construction-paper panels with torn and scissor-cut edges and REAL drop shadows (powder blue, rust orange, black), paper-cut characters and objects with visible paper grain, die-cut black caps title strip, kraft-paper arrows, tactile hand-glued composition.
16-retro-memphis: Memphis 80s-90s: cream ground scattered with confetti shapes (black squiggles, pink and teal triangles, dots, zigzags), big organic blob panels in teal and hot pink, chunky flat black shapes with sharp geometry, a patterned arrow (pink/black triangles), mustard-gold drips, headline split black + hot pink in heavy caps.
17-apple-dark-keynote: Apple-style dark keynote: pure black ground, thin-weight white headline in title case with tight tracking, small letterspaced gray caps labels, sculpted matte 3D objects (sage-green and porcelain-white ceramic look) with soft studio lighting and one warm inner glow, a single thin white arrow, vast negative space, quiet premium minimalism.
18-sticky-note-workshop: Workshop wall (photoreal): warm gray wall, white index cards pinned with blue push-pins and masking tape, yellow/blue/pink sticky notes with black marker hand-writing, pencil-sketch doodles on the cards, an orange cut-paper arrow taped between panels, soft daylight shadows, facilitation-session realism.
19-bauhaus-geometric: Bauhaus print: off-white ground, large flat cobalt-blue and signal-red squares with rough ink-print edges, elemental black geometry (triangle roof, squares, circles), green stripe pattern, stamped black boxed caps labels, heavy black caps headline, solid black triangle as the arrow, constructivist asymmetric balance.
20-scifi-hud: Sci-fi HUD: near-black ground with faint grid, glowing cyan interface frames with angled corner cutouts, wireframe-mesh figures and structures in cyan, an orange/red alert panel with warning triangles and spark particles, dashed data-flow arrows with node squares, mono-style caps labels, status badges (check-shield, alert-triangle), scan-line glow.
custom: The operator uploaded their own style reference. Derive the style vocabulary by STUDYING the baseline image: name its palette, textures, lettering style, linework, lighting, and composition conventions explicitly in every prompt, and stay strictly inside that world.
